taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kor-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1916 | 1.24 | 1.24
2 | 1252 | 1.79 | 3.03
3 | 1658 | 108 | 111
4 | 581 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kor-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HK-type
Aquifer depth: below 111 m (Layer 4, resistivity 581 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Drill and case through the upper resistive layers to 111 m depth, then proceed into the lower-resistivity Layer 4, which represents the probable aquifer zone; confirm water strike and yield by penetrating sufficiently into this layer before terminating the borehole.
